meals.name: Greek Yogurt Banana Oat Bowl
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Cook the oats with 150ml water in a small pot over medium heat for 4-5 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Step 2: Spoon the oats into a bowl and let them cool for 1 minute.
Step 3: Top with the greek yogurt and sliced banana.
Step 4: Serve immediately.

meals.name: Chicken and Broccoli Rice Bowl
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Cook the white rice according to package directions and keep warm.
Step 2: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Step 3: Pan-cook the chicken in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes until cooked through.
Step 4: Steam the broccoli florets for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Step 5: Assemble the rice, chicken and broccoli in a bowl and serve.

meals.name: Chicken, Egg and Broccoli Rice Plate
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Cook the white rice according to package directions and keep warm.
Step 2: Cut the chicken breast into strips and season with salt, pepper and garlic powder if available.
Step 3: Pan-cook the chicken in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes until cooked through, then set aside.
Step 4: Steam the broccoli for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Step 5: Scramble the eggs in the same skillet over medium-low heat for 2-3 minutes until just set.
Step 6: Plate the rice with the chicken, broccoli and scrambled eggs and serve.

meals.name: Tofu and Spinach Brown Rice Bowl
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Cook the brown rice according to the package directions and keep it warm.
Step 2: Press the tofu for 5 minutes to remove excess water, then cut it into 2 cm cubes.
Step 3: Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the tofu cubes for 6-8 minutes, turning until golden on all sides.
Step 4: Slice the bell pepper into thin strips and add them to the pan. Cook for 3 minutes.
Step 5: Add the spinach and cook for 1-2 minutes until just wilted.
Step 6: Add the soy sauce, if using, and toss everything together.
Step 7: Serve the tofu and vegetable mix over the brown rice.

meals.name: Spinach and Pepper Egg Scramble with Brown Rice
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Cook the brown rice according to the package directions and keep it warm.
Step 2: Dice the bell pepper into small pieces.
Step 3: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the bell pepper for 3 minutes until softened.
Step 4: Add the spinach and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Step 5: Beat the eggs in a bowl, pour them into the pan, and gently stir for 3-4 minutes until just set.
Step 6: Serve the scramble alongside the brown rice.

meals.name: Crispy Chickpea & Kale Sweet Potato Hash
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Dice the sweet potato into small 1 cm cubes.
Step 2: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add the diced sweet potato with a splash of water. Cover and cook for 8 minutes, stirring once, until nearly tender.
Step 3: Add the chickpeas and cook uncovered for 5 minutes until lightly crisp. Season with salt, smoked paprika and black pepper.
Step 4: Add the chopped kale and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until wilted. Serve hot.

meals.name: Quinoa, Kale & Chickpea Power Bowl
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Rinse the quinoa and cook 40 g dry quinoa in 100 ml water for 15 minutes, or until the water is absorbed. Let it rest 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Step 2: Wash the kale, remove the tough stems and chop finely. Massage with a pinch of salt and the lemon juice for 1 minute to soften.
Step 3: Pat the chickpeas dry and warm them in a small pan for 4 minutes with cumin and garlic powder.
Step 4: Combine the quinoa, kale and chickpeas in a bowl and season with black pepper and extra lemon juice.

meals.name: Stuffed Sweet Potato with Avocado & Chickpeas
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Pierce the sweet potato several times with a fork.
Step 2: Bake the sweet potato for 40 to 45 minutes until soft when pressed.
Step 3: While it bakes, sauté the chickpeas in a pan for 6 minutes with paprika and salt until golden. Add the chopped kale and cook 2 minutes until wilted.
Step 4: Split the sweet potato open, top with the chickpea and kale mix and sliced avocado. Season with black pepper.

meals.name: Salmon and Avocado Spinach Salad
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Season the salmon with salt and pepper.
Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Cook the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip and cook 3 to 4 minutes more until just cooked through. Set aside to cool slightly and flake.
Step 3: Wash the spinach and place it in a bowl.
Step 4: Halve and pit the avocado, slice it, and arrange it over the spinach.
Step 5: Top with the flaked salmon, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

meals.name: Zucchini Ribbons with Salmon and Spinach Scramble
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Wash the zucchini and shave it into ribbons with a vegetable peeler, discarding the seedy core.
Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the zucchini ribbons and cook 2 to 3 minutes until just tender. Move to a plate.
Step 3: Season the salmon with salt and pepper. In the same pan over medium-high heat, cook the salmon 3 to 4 minutes per side until cooked through. Flake it and set aside.
Step 4: Lower the heat to medium. Beat the eggs with salt and pepper, pour into the pan, and gently stir until softly set.
Step 5: Add the spinach and stir until wilted, about 1 minute.
Step 6: Return the zucchini and salmon to the pan, toss gently to combine, and serve hot.

meals.name: Protein Egg and Cottage Cheese Scramble
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Crack the 3 eggs into a bowl and whisk well with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Step 2: Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Step 3: Pour in the eggs and cook slowly, stirring gently, for about 2 minutes.
Step 4: Fold in the cottage cheese and cook for 1 more minute until just set and creamy.
Step 5: Serve immediately.

meals.name: Beef and Black Bean Potato Bowl
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Scrub the potato, cut it into 2 cm cubes, and place in a pot of boiling salted water. Cook for 12 to 15 minutes until tender, then drain.
Step 2: While the potato cooks, heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Step 3: Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up, for 5 to 6 minutes until browned. Drain excess fat and season with salt and pepper.
Step 4: Rinse and drain the black beans, then add them to the pan with the beef and warm through for 2 minutes.
Step 5: Add the drained potato to the pan, toss with the beef and beans for 1 minute, and serve hot.

meals.name: Garlic Soy Chicken with Brown Rice and Broccoli
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Cook the brown rice according to package directions (or use pre-cooked rice) and keep warm.
Step 2: Pat the chicken breast dry, cut it into bite-sized pieces, and season lightly with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Step 3: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 5-6 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and cooked through (internal temperature 74°C / 165°F). Remove and set aside.
Step 4: Add the minced garlic to the same pan and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Step 5: Add the broccoli florets with 2 tablespoons of water, cover and steam for 3-4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Step 6: Return the chicken to the pan, add the soy sauce and toss for 1 minute to coat.
Step 7: Serve the garlic soy chicken and broccoli over the brown rice.

meals.name: Lentil and Carrot Stew
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Dice the onion and peel and slice the carrots into thin rounds.
Step 2: Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened.
Step 3: Add the carrots and cook for another 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Step 4: Rinse the lentils and add them to the pan with the stock or water.
Step 5: Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes, until the lentils are tender and the stew has thickened.
Step 6: Season with salt, pepper and any dried herbs you have, then serve hot.

meals.name: Tomato and Egg Scramble
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
meals.recipe:
Step 1: Dice the tomato into small bite-sized pieces.
Step 2: Crack the 2 eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt and pepper, and whisk well.
Step 3: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Step 4: Add the diced tomato and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until softened.
Step 5: Pour in the beaten eggs and gently stir with a spatula for 2 to 3 minutes, until just set but still soft.
Step 6: Season to taste and serve immediately.

workouts.name: Beginner Full-Body Strength Foundations
workouts.description: Builds muscle across the whole body to raise daily calorie burn, which supports fat loss. Low-impact, controlled movements suit a sedentary starting point and no recent training history.
workouts.warmup: 5 min brisk walking in place, 10 arm circles each direction, 10 bodyweight squats, 10 standing hip hinges.
workouts.cooldown: 5 min easy walking, then gentle stretches for chest, hamstrings, and quads (30 seconds each side).

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat to Chair
exercises.formTip: Keep your chest up and push your knees out over your toes as you sit back to lightly touch a chair.
exercises.notes: Use a higher chair if needed.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up (against a counter or bench)
exercises.formTip: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels and lower your chest toward the surface.
exercises.notes: Raise the surface height to make it easier.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Row
exercises.formTip: Pull your elbows back toward your hips and squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
exercises.notes: Use a resistance band if no dumbbells are available.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.formTip: Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes at the top without arching your lower back.
exercises.notes: Pause 2 seconds at the top for more challenge.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.formTip: Keep your lower back pressed into the floor while extending opposite arm and leg slowly.
exercises.notes: Core stability exercise; move slowly.

workouts.name: Low-Impact Cardio Walk Intervals
workouts.description: Steady cardio is an accessible way for a sedentary person to burn calories and build aerobic fitness without joint stress. Walking intervals let you progress gradually.
workouts.warmup: 5 min slow walk, followed by gentle leg swings and ankle rolls.
workouts.cooldown: 5 min slow walk, then calf stretch and seated hamstring stretch (30 seconds each).

exercises.name: Brisk Walk Intervals
exercises.intensity: Moderate, talk-test: can speak in short sentences
exercises.structure: Alternate 3 min brisk walking with 2 min slow walking, repeated 6 times.
exercises.notes: Increase brisk segments by 1 minute every two weeks as fitness improves. Wear supportive shoes.

workouts.name: Beginner Low-Impact HIIT Circuit
workouts.description: Short bursts of effort with full recovery keep the workout time-efficient and effective for fat loss, while low-impact moves protect joints during early training.
workouts.warmup: 3 min marching in place, 10 arm swings, 10 bodyweight squats, 10 standing knee raises.
workouts.cooldown: 3 min slow walking, then deep breathing and a standing quad and chest stretch (30 seconds each).

exercises.name: Step-Out Squat Jacks
exercises.notes: Step one foot out at a time instead of jumping to keep impact low.

exercises.name: Standing Knee Drives with Arm Press
exercises.notes: Alternate knees while pressing arms forward; keep a steady pace.

exercises.name: Marching Reverse Lunge (alternating)
exercises.notes: Hold a wall or chair for balance; step back gently and return to standing.

exercises.name: Standing Side Bends with Reach
exercises.notes: Reach overhead and lean to each side in a controlled manner.

workouts.name: Pull Strength
workouts.description: Your last session was Push Day, so this session trains your back and biceps to balance your pressing work. Heavy compound pulls build mass for your muscle-gain goal, and your Very Active level supports the higher volume.
workouts.warmup: 5 min rowing machine or light cycling at an easy pace, then 2 sets of 10 band pull-aparts and 10 scapular pull-ups to activate the lats and upper back.
workouts.cooldown: 5 min easy walking, then static stretches for lats (doorway lat stretch, 30 sec each side), biceps (30 sec each arm), and upper back (child's pose, 60 sec).

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.weight: Bodyweight, add load if reps exceed 10
exercises.formTip: Start each rep by depressing your shoulder blades, then pull your elbows toward your hips rather than pulling with your arms.
exercises.notes: Use assisted pull-up or band support if you cannot yet complete 6 reps.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.formTip: Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back, and pull the bar to your lower ribs while keeping your elbows close to your body.
exercises.notes: Brace your core before every rep to protect your lower back.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
exercises.weight: Moderate, enough to control the full range
exercises.formTip: Lead with your elbows and drive them down toward your back pockets, keeping your chest tall.
exercises.notes: Avoid leaning back excessively to prevent swinging the weight.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (Close Grip)
exercises.formTip: Keep your torso upright and pull the handle to your navel, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the end of each rep.
exercises.notes: Pause for one second at full contraction.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.formTip: Let your arms hang straight down on an incline bench, then curl without letting your elbows drift forward.
exercises.notes: The slow eccentric stretches the biceps and supports growth.

workouts.name: Lower Body Strength
workouts.description: This leg session fills the lower-body gap in your training and uses heavy compound lifts to build muscle. Since you are Very Active, you can handle the volume and recover between sessions.
workouts.warmup: 5 min stationary bike, then 2 sets of 10 bodyweight squats, 10 glute bridges, and 10 leg swings per side.
workouts.cooldown: 5 min easy walking, then stretch quads (standing quad stretch, 30 sec per side), hamstrings (seated forward fold, 45 sec), and calves (wall calf stretch, 30 sec per side).

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.formTip: Brace your core, keep your chest up, and push your knees out in line with your toes as you descend.
exercises.notes: Use safety pins or a spotter when going heavy.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.formTip: Push your hips back with a slight knee bend and keep the bar close to your legs until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
exercises.notes: Stop lowering when your back begins to round.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.formTip: Keep your front foot flat and your torso upright as you lower your back knee toward the floor.
exercises.notes: Place your back foot on a bench about 60 cm behind you.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.formTip: Keep your hips pressed into the pad and curl the weight by bringing your heels toward your glutes.
exercises.notes: Lower slowly to maximize hamstring tension.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.formTip: Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause at the top, and lower under control to a full stretch.
exercises.notes: Pause at the bottom of each rep for the best calf growth.

workouts.name: Posterior Chain and Pull Power
workouts.description: This full-focus session combines hip-dominant lifts with pulling work. It avoids chest, shoulders, and triceps, so it works well after Push Day and supports building muscle with good recovery.
workouts.warmup: 5 min rowing at easy pace, then 2 sets of 10 cat-cow, 10 glute bridges, and 5 light deadlifts with an empty bar.
workouts.cooldown: 5 min walking, then stretch glutes (figure-four stretch, 30 sec per side), hamstrings (supine hamstring stretch, 30 sec per leg), and lats (side bend stretch, 30 sec per side).

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.formTip: Keep the bar over mid-foot, brace hard, and push the floor away with your legs while keeping your back neutral.
exercises.notes: Reset your setup between reps to keep form consistent.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.formTip: Place your hand and knee on a bench, then pull the dumbbell toward your hip while keeping your torso still.
exercises.notes: Focus on squeezing the lat at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.weight: Moderate-heavy barbell or dumbbell on hips
exercises.formTip: Drive through your heels and lock out your hips at the top, keeping your ribs down to avoid overarching your lower back.
exercises.notes: Pause for one second at the top for maximal glute activation.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.weight: Bodyweight, add load if reps exceed 10
exercises.formTip: Use an underhand grip and pull your chest toward the bar while driving your elbows down.
exercises.notes: Use assistance bands if needed to complete full reps.

exercises.name: Alternating Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercises.formTip: Keep your palms facing each other and your elbows pinned to your sides throughout the curl.
exercises.notes: Hammer curls also work the brachialis for added arm thickness.

workouts.name: Gentle Full-Body Stretch Flow
workouts.description: A balanced, beginner-friendly stretch session suited to a lightly active person with no recent training history. It opens the major areas that tighten from daily sitting and light activity, supporting mobility and an easier routine that pairs well with a healthier eating plan.
workouts.warmup: 2 min easy marching in place, then 1 min of arm circles and gentle torso twists to raise body temperature and prepare joints.
workouts.cooldown: 3 min of slow diaphragmatic breathing lying on your back, knees bent, letting the body fully relax.

exercises.name: Standing Forward Fold
exercises.breathingCue: Inhale to lengthen the spine, exhale to fold deeper
exercises.notes: Bend knees slightly if hamstrings feel tight. Let the head and arms hang loosely.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Opener
exercises.breathingCue: Slow inhale through the nose, long exhale while easing into the stretch
exercises.notes: Place forearm on a door frame at shoulder height and gently step forward. Avoid arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
exercises.breathingCue: Exhale to fold forward from the hips
exercises.notes: Keep a straight back and a slight bend in the front knee if needed. Use a strap or towel if you cannot reach your foot.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.breathingCue: Breathe deeply and exhale to sink the hips forward
exercises.notes: Squeeze the glute of the back leg to increase the stretch. Pad the knee with a folded towel.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.breathingCue: Inhale to arch and lift the chest, exhale to round the spine
exercises.notes: Move slowly and keep wrists under shoulders.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Stretch
exercises.notes: Keep the back heel grounded and the back leg straight.

workouts.name: Desk-Break Mobility Reset
workouts.description: A short, low-intensity routine aimed at counteracting stiffness from sitting. It is well suited to a lightly active user looking for an easy daily habit that improves posture and comfort without demanding much time or effort.
workouts.warmup: 2 min of gentle walking on the spot and slow shoulder rolls forward and backward.
workouts.cooldown: 2 min of lying on your back with knees hugged gently to the chest, breathing slowly.

exercises.name: Neck Side Stretch
exercises.breathingCue: Slow exhale as you lower the ear toward the shoulder
exercises.notes: Keep shoulders relaxed and down. Do not force the stretch.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
exercises.breathingCue: Exhale as you rotate and reach under the arm
exercises.notes: Start on hands and knees. Keep hips stacked over knees.

exercises.name: Supine Figure-Four Glute Stretch
exercises.breathingCue: Deep belly breaths, relaxing into the hip
exercises.notes: Keep the head and shoulders on the floor. Pull the thigh gently toward the chest.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
exercises.breathingCue: Inhale to prepare, exhale to bend the knee
exercises.notes: Hold a wall or chair for balance. Keep knees close together and the hips tucked.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.breathingCue: Let the breath expand into the back body
exercises.notes: Walk the hands forward to deepen the stretch through the lats and upper back.

workouts.name: Evening Unwind Yoga Flow
workouts.description: A calming, slow-paced session designed for winding down after the day. It supports relaxation and recovery, which helps with consistent habits such as mindful eating and better sleep, and suits a lightly active user with no previous workout history.
workouts.warmup: 3 min of slow breathing while seated comfortably, then gentle side bends and seated spinal rotations.
workouts.cooldown: 4 min of savasana, lying flat with arms relaxed at the sides and eyes closed, breathing naturally.

exercises.name: Child's Pose with Side Reach
exercises.breathingCue: Inhale to reach, exhale to sink deeper
exercises.notes: Walk hands to one side to lengthen the opposite side of the torso.

exercises.name: Downward-Facing Dog
exercises.breathingCue: Steady inhale and exhale through the nose
exercises.notes: Bend knees generously to protect the lower back. Press the hands firmly into the floor.

exercises.name: Low Lunge with Reach
exercises.breathingCue: Inhale to lift the chest, exhale to lower the hips
exercises.notes: Keep the front knee over the ankle and use a pad under the back knee.

exercises.name: Reclined Twist
exercises.notes: Keep both shoulders grounded on the floor and let the knees fall gently.

exercises.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch with Strap
exercises.breathingCue: Long, slow exhale as the leg gently straightens
exercises.notes: Keep the opposite leg flat on the floor. Use a towel or strap if needed.

exercises.name: Bridge Pose
exercises.breathingCue: Inhale to lift, exhale to lower slowly
exercises.notes: Press through the feet and squeeze the glutes at the top. Keep the neck relaxed.
